QUOTE: "Single token, unread corpus holds a match | "NOT DEFINITIVE… the name exists… ask dossier" | The name exists; search just cannot see that kind" and "Single token, no unread-corpus hits, file docs present | "definitive empty result… do not retry""
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer separates definitive from not definitive, and the unread-corpus case (name exists elsewhere) is a form of "definitive for a reason that is not absence". It never states that third grade as a distinct category, though, and it doesn't identify the three grades the item requires.
